name: nova-commerce
description: Nova production-grade enterprise e-commerce platform foundation.

scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:api && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.lint: npm run lint:api && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present
scripts.db:generate: npm run env:ensure && node --env-file=.env ./node_modules/prisma/build/index.js generate --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:validate: npm run env:ensure && node --env-file=.env ./node_modules/prisma/build/index.js validate --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:format: npm run env:ensure && node --env-file=.env ./node_modules/prisma/build/index.js format --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:migrate:dev: npm run env:ensure && node --env-file=.env ./node_modules/prisma/build/index.js migrate dev --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:migrate:status: npm run env:ensure && node --env-file=.env ./node_modules/prisma/build/index.js migrate status --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:migrate:check: npm run db:validate && npm run db:migrate:status
scripts.db:studio: npm run env:ensure && node --env-file=.env ./node_modules/prisma/build/index.js studio --schema prisma/schema.prisma
